Imperial College London is hiring an RA and postdoc for work into digital wellbeing and gaming.

We're looking for a postdoc (quant, RCTs, software development) and an RA (qual + participatory research) to support the Kaleidoscope project - a year-long study of early adolescents combining multi-platform tracked video game play + EMA methods + family interventions. Ultimately, we want to give families/teens concrete advice about how to foster healthy relationships with games.

Led by Dr Nick Ballou alongside by the wonderful Prof Sebastian Deterding and Dr Martina Di Simplicio, these will be foundational hires with real ownership of the work.

Feel free to get in touch with me (n.ballou@imperial.ac.uk) with any questions.

🧑‍🔬Postdoc (24 months) - quantitative/technical. Aimed at those with experience in intensive longitudinal data, experiments/causal inference, multilevel modelling, and building data infrastructure (API pipelines, ESM tools, etc), even if your background isn't in digital wellbeing. Strong R/Python and open research skills essential.

🧑‍🔬Research Assistant (12–24 months) - qualitative & community lead. Ideal for those excited about working directly with adolescents and families from both a qualitative research and participatory research perspective. Tasks include recruiting participants, conducting interviews, running school partnerships. Independent research highly encouraged.
